question: Should JSON-string `channelData` be accepted as dispatchable content while any protected runtime-context match in its opaque nested payload causes the entire `channelData` object to be dropped?
rationale: This is a shared outbound security and compatibility contract for provider-owned opaque data; source review cannot determine whether all channel integrations agree with the intended fail-closed behavior.

options.title: Approve the fail-closed opaque-data contract
options.body: Keep the proposed parser and whole-payload suppression rule after a current-head proof confirms the documented safe, rejected, and mixed-text cases.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Specify supported object shapes and whether protected context should reject or sanitize particular provider payloads before revising the helper and tests.
